# Ghostty X11 color reference

`crates/zz-terminal/src/x11-rgb.txt` is copied from Ghostty's
`src/terminal/res/rgb.txt` at upstream commit
`cf60af281bd7559a819aa25372cef01d623b8c5a`.

Ghostty records the data as sourced from the X.Org `rgb` project and licensed
under the MIT/X11 license. The accompanying Ghostty MIT license is retained in
this directory.
